html.title: My App - Project Template
html.description: A Python project template with a four-layer backend skeleton, dual auth domains, two frontends, and observability. Ships with no business domain.

hero.badge: A project template built for long-term evolution
hero.subtitle: A four-layer modular monolith with dual auth domains and observability. No business domain inside, so every derived project starts its own from scratch.
hero.highlightAuth: Auth works out of the box

features.sectionSubtitle: The template only promises engineering capabilities; business boundaries are yours

architecture.title: Four-layer backend architecture
architecture.description: api / core / engines / infrastructure depend inwards and collaborate through abstract interfaces, keeping business logic decoupled from infrastructure.

authDomains.title: Dual auth domains
authDomains.description: The public self-service registration domain and the admin seed-created domain are physically isolated, each with its own cookies, session namespace, and user table.

frontends.title: Dual frontend skeletons
frontends.description: An admin console (Vite + React) and a public site (Next.js) work out of the box, talking to the backend only over /api/* HTTP.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Request IDs, structured logging, and Prometheus metrics are wired behind switches, with platform-agnostic log and metric formats.

config.title: Unified configuration
config.description: pydantic-settings with three layers: environment variables, config.toml, and code defaults. Secrets only ever live in .env.

teamwork.title: Team engineering
teamwork.description: just task runner, pre-commit + Ruff, Alembic migration chain guards, and a template sync script, all ready to use.

steps.sectionSubtitle: Copy the template, configure the environment, start the services

copy.title: Copy the template
copy.description: Run just copy <name> to create a new project without dependencies or build artifacts.

configure.title: Configure the environment
configure.description: Fill in the database, Redis, and initial admin following .env.example.

run.title: Start the services
run.description: Run just sync dev to install dependencies, then just run to boot the backend and both frontends.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Things you may want to know about this template

audience.question: What kind of project is this template for?
audience.answer: Long-lived Python web projects: a clear layered skeleton and engineering facilities first, then business modules on top.

businessCode.question: Does the template ship business code?
businessCode.answer: No business domain is included. Auth, configuration, observability, and persistence are the only skeleton; derived projects add their own business modules.

createProject.question: How do I create a new project from the template?
createProject.answer: Use just copy <name> to copy it into a standalone project, then configure environment variables and the database as described in the README.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.body: Create an account, enter the protected area, and build your business on a clean backend skeleton.

aboutPage.title: About this template
aboutPage.description: A Python template for starting new projects: a four-layer backend skeleton, dual auth domains, and complete engineering facilities. It deliberately ships no business domain, so every derived project builds its own from a clean starting point.

simple.title: Simplicity first
simple.description: Strip the unnecessary complexity and keep only what is genuinely reusable.

security.title: Security first
security.description: From authentication to data storage, security is always the top priority.

evolution.title: Continuous evolution
evolution.description: The skeleton keeps improving while business boundaries stay with derived projects.

featuresPage.title: Template capabilities
featuresPage.subtitle: Engineering skeleton only — no business domain included

architecture.title: Four-layer architecture
architecture.description: api / core / engines / infrastructure depend inwards, with cross-layer interfaces decoupled.

authDomains.title: Dual auth domains
authDomains.description: public and admin are physically isolated, using HttpOnly sessions backed by Redis.

frontends.title: Dual frontend skeletons
frontends.description: An admin console (Vite + React) and a public site (Next.js), ready to use out of the box.

config.title: Unified configuration
config.description: Three configuration layers — environment variables, config.toml, and code defaults — with secrets only in .env.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Request IDs, structured logging, and Prometheus metrics, wired behind switches.

tooling.title: Complete engineering setup
tooling.description: just tasks, pre-commit + Ruff, Alembic migration guards, and template sync.

pricingPage.title: Open-source license
pricingPage.description: This template is provided as an open-source project. Derived projects are entirely free of commercial restrictions.
pricingPage.cardDescription: Start any project from the template, and the business code is yours.

items.copy: Copy it into a standalone project and develop it freely
items.deploy: Deploy privately or on the cloud — no obligation to open-source
items.modify: Modify the skeleton code and configuration as needed
items.license: Keep the original copyright and license notices
